statement: Complete the Hog and Do's quest line at least partway on entering World 3 to get the printer sampling and shrine artifact star talents.
Equip the Printer Sampling star talent on your skill bar so you can take samples for the 3D printer.
Equip the Shrine Artifact star talent to be able to place down shrines.
Printer Sampling and Shrine Artifact are absolute staples and should never be skipped.
Buy wax skulls and cardboard box straps for all characters at the World 3 shop to place traps and generate worship charge.
Tools can give free stat points so spend a few upgrade stones on them to get the most out of them.
The 3D printer is a huge pain but there are rules of thumb to get a head start.
Acorn Assault level 21 unlocks Royal Sampler which gives a ton of sample rate.
Sample rate is the percentage of your AFK info that the sample takes and caps at 90%.
Example: with 400 oak logs AFK info and 50% printer sample the sample would be 200 oak logs.
You can check your sample rate stat in the construction skill info on the character menu.
Focus on getting prints that fill your refinery because being salt locked is one of the biggest early game soft locks for gear progression.
For combat prints multi-kill sample rate and AFK gains are your best stats.
For skilling prints skill efficiency and skilling speed plus sample rate and AFK gains are your best stats.
Equip a couple of skilling foods then take a print then remove the food to preserve the buff and boost prints.
Multi-resource bubbles like multilogo or wyming blood or other big bubbles are massive for prints on top of sample rate.
The first multi-resource threshold is 300% but with certain upgrades you can max it out at 600%.
He has a linked video on getting 90% samples and figuring out what to print without much effort.
When building out the construction workbench your top priority should be the 3D printer the first building on the top row.
Each printer level allows one more character to print different materials for free every hour.
Printer is the main way to farm tons of materials for crafting gear and leveling stamps and boosting alchemy bubbles.
The Death Note is the third building on the top row and unlocks multi-kill.
As you kill enough of each monster you increase multi-kill per tier giving credit for multiple monsters per hit.
Between multi-kill stat and damage tiers you go from killing thousands of monsters per hour to millions.
After unlocking and leveling those buildings the next priority is unlocking all the shrines as soon as possible.
Shrines provide free bonuses that level up over time with AFK hours so unlock them as early as possible.
Boulder rollers are best in slot until poisonic pen towers whenever possible.
The next phase starts when you unlock poisonic pen.
Poisonic pen air tower removes special abilities from mobs spawning each wave which helps maximize poisonic pen.
Check Nocturn Gaming's dedicated tower defense guides linked in the description.
Hard focus construction cogs and booster cogs for construction exp.
The cog board gives build rate for constructing towers shrines and other buildings and is unlocked using flags.
Most cog stats are bait so you want xp% on all of your cogs.
Check cog stats by pressing the eyeball icon at the top.
99% of your build rate and flaggy rate comes from your Squires.
Best setup is two Squires dedicated to build rate for the cog board.
Prioritizing flag rate to unlock the board faster is possible but you save more time sticking to xp% cogs.
Every other character should be farming cogs.
Carpenter bubble gives build rate percentage per construction level which makes xp% cogs so strong.
Keep running exp percentage cogs until at least 1500 to 2000 construction levels on each Squire even in late game.
As you build different colored cogs you can build booster cogs that enhance stats on characters or cogs on the board.
Go all in on XP% booster cogs because the ramp up is insane; max xp% is 65%.
Spend your library books often once the talent book library is unlocked from the construction workbench.
Library books upgrade maximum levels of specific talents.
Books generate over time but the more books stocked the slower new ones generate so spin them frequently.
There is an achievement for spending 1000 library books.
Early talent priorities are similar for all characters; start with skill books increasing damage or skill efficiency.
Tab 1 priorities: sharp attacks gilded sword brute efficiency idle brawling and idle skilling.
Tab 2 damage priorities: carry a big stick strength and numbers firmly grasp it and absolute unit.
Tab 2 skilling priorities: copper collector motherlode miner and tool proficiency.
Tab 3 damage priorities: strength some more apocalypse Z and the attack talents on the top row.
Tab 3 skilling priorities: Bob and Bobbers catching some Zs and worming undercover.
Eventually upgrade all talents; further worlds give bonuses to increase maximum talent level.
To hard push the world use Time Candy because World 3 is a slog.
On the progressing map with your Squire place all shrines then equip big HP potions from World 3 and food.
Use the bricky skin ability before using a Time Candy for big survivability and damage reduction to push further.
Shrines level based on AFK time so popping Time Candy also levels shrines.
With enough Time Candy pushing to Neptunes is easy; it is brute forcing but gives lots of XP for talent points.
Don't collect red salts early; let them rank up in the refinery.
Collecting salt when the power bar is full ranks it up to the next level.
Each rank produces two times the amount of salts for the same time but needs more salts to level and more materials per salt.
You need millions of salts so take your time ranking up as it makes life easier later.
Use the 3D printer to generate free materials for salt early such as printing green spore caps and copper ore on multiple characters.
With higher damage multi-kill and skill efficiency you can print more than enough materials to never run out.
Salts are one of the biggest bottlenecks so always be refining salts.
Rule of thumb: never early refine red and green salts; always rank them up first.
Spend worship charge on all your characters to unlock new skulls with higher charge capacity and speed and better stats.
If desperate for souls use the Wizard talent charge siphon; otherwise getting exp rewards more souls later.
Spending charge on every character is more worth it than using one super juiced wizard soaking up all the exp.
Maestro talent Right of Action increases skill efficiency for other characters if it is the highest level giving more souls from the wizard.
Unlock the Equinox as soon as you can; it makes your journey much smoother since it is time gated.
Go to blood bones two maps from crossroads at Cstashes; it can drop a mirror which when consumed takes you to the Equinox.
Equinox has special material and challenges with insanely strong unlocks that make some mechanics ridiculously easy.
At the end of World 3 the NPC Bellows gives keys needed to fight the World 3 boss.
His first two quests give keys; the third quest gives one key per day per character completion.
Save giant spawns for the third Bellows quest which requires killing a giant.
Giants spawn by equipping Titan talent a prerequisite unlock from Wakawaka tower defense at wave 11.
Each giant kill increases spawn chance and it only resets weekly.
Use one or two giants each week to unlock the daily keys on each character.
Spawn the dilapitated slush in the blocks map with the bucket of slush.
The bucket of slush recipe drops from drop table 15 including mobs like Chrome Crystal cattle and blocks.
The mini boss drops best in slot skilling obols and crafting reagents for the best worship skull at time of video.
Do not use the slush skull; its stats look cool but the worship charge is terrible.
Drop the bucket on the snowball spawn to summon the dilapitated slush and defeat it.
You can also fight the dilapitated slush in the World 3 Coliseum.
